stem: For September, the ad platforms show €28,000 of paid social spend, while finance's booked invoices show €30,500 for the same channel. Display has figures from both sources as well. How should the monthly spend report by channel be built?

options.text: From one source for every channel, with fees handled the same way
From whichever source shows the higher figure for each channel
From finance for channels with fees and the platforms for the rest
From both sources added together, so that no spend is left out
